observed_capture_design.colorchecker_illumination: D50 Bron tungsten flashbulbs with softboxes, reported color temperature 5500 K; Kodachrome exception under daylight
observed_capture_design.colorchecker_exposure_semantics: films shot at various exposures; row-level exposure mapping is not published
observed_capture_design.coloraid_input_semantics: film-recorder device values, not camera scene exposure
observed_capture_design.coloraid_exposure_semantics: same reported light exposure for all slides
observed_capture_design.digitisation: hyperspectral camera; D65 and CIE 1931 2 degree observer conversion

source_thesis_repository.title: Chromatic Divide: von der Farbigwerdung medialer Repräsentation am Beispiel der Fotografie
source_thesis_repository.repository_license_scope: non-exclusive repository distribution and preservation only; no dataset reuse grant

availability_audit.provenance_fact: the paper acknowledges that Zurich Central Library provided the film-stock dataset to the authors

decision.reopen_condition: an official source releases immutable per-patch film measurements or raw scans, target/reference values, exposure/process/scanner lineage and explicit reusable data rights

claim_ceiling: publication-level evidence for a strong controlled reversal-film target design and explicit correction baselines; no reusable chart pairs, camera-scene stock response, operator fit, training, calibration, authenticity or product promotion
